subject: Post-call: Deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - FintechX
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Arman Shah <arman.shah@fintechx.com>
Cc: Priya Iyer <priya.iyer@fintechx.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - FintechX

Hi Arman / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand FintechX's fraud-detection roadmap and the production constraints you called out. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions to help us recommend the right deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem):

Recap from call:
- Goal: Reduce false positives for real-time transaction scoring and add secure on-prem audit logging for regulated markets.
- Current infra: self-hosted models on legacy GPU clusters, nightly batch updates, and one low-latency endpoint used for enrichment.
- Key constraints: data residency and audit logs, 99th percentile latency target ~80ms, and predictable monthly cost.

Clarifying questions (one-liners):
1) Can you confirm whether any regulated data must stay on-prem or in your VPC? If so, which markets/regions?
2) What is your current p95/p99 token-per-request and average QPS for the enrichment endpoint? An estimate is fine.
3) Do you expect to host proprietary models or will you run open models we can serve?

Suggested initial recommendation (based on today's notes):
- If you must keep data in your VPC and need KMS/HSM integration + on-prem audits: Private VPC/on-prem.
- If you need predictable throughput and dedicated GPUs but want Redwood-managed runtime and lower ops: Dedicated capacity.
- If you want fastest time-to-value and no infra ops: Hosted API (with routing & fallback to Dedicated for peak).

Next steps I propose:
- Sean (cc'd) will follow up with a short technical questionnaire to capture QPS, token counts, and model footprints.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive next week to map your traffic to cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Share SOC2 summary and a short infra cost/usage snapshot (attachment) so we can do a preliminary sizing.

I attached a template for the usage table — no need to be exact.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: current_infra_costs.xlsx

Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - FintechX

Marissa,

Appreciate the clear recap — that aligns with our notes. Quick answers inline: 
1) Data residency: For our EU customers we need logs & transaction-level data to remain in our EU VPC. For US it's fine in a cloud provider, but audit logs must be accessible to our security team.
2) Latency/QPS: The enrichment endpoint averages ~120 QPS during peak hour; median token-per-request ~75, p95 ~220 tokens. P99 we haven't measured precisely but expect around 400 tokens for some longer contexts.
3) Models: We run a mix — a proprietary post-processing model (small) and open LLMs for scoring. We would like the proprietary model to stay within our environment if possible.

Given that, I think Dedicated or Private are both on the table. Dedicated gives us the predictability we want, but Private VPC/on-prem may be required for EU logs and the proprietary model. Can Sean share a quick matrix on tradeoffs and estimated monthly costs for each option? Also, we attached a brief SOC2 summary for initial compliance review.

Thanks,
Arman
Head of ML Platforms | FintechX
arman.shah@fintechx.com | +1 (212) 555-0899

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - FintechX

Hi Arman / Team,

Thanks for the context — I took a first pass and below is a concise tradeoff matrix and a short checklist of what we'd need to size a Dedicated or Private deployment. If helpful I can convert this into a 1-page PDF.

Tradeoff summary (short):
- Hosted API:
  * Pros: fastest onboarding, Redwood handles ops, built-in model catalog and autoscaling. Good if you want time-to-value and are OK with routing logs to our managed service (we support strict retention configs).
  * Cons: May not meet EU on-prem residency requirements for raw transaction logs unless you use our EU-hosted private logging bridge; less control for proprietary models.

- Dedicated capacity:
  * Pros: Dedicated GPU pools (predictable throughput), lower unit cost at scale, Redwood-managed runtime but isolated to your tenant. Supports KMS and audit logging into your cloud account (VPC peering or private network).
  * Cons: Requires commit for capacity (monthly/annual); some setup time. If proprietary model must be inside your private network, we can support model import into your Dedicated environment but will need secure model transfer process.

- Private VPC / On-prem:
  * Pros: Full data residency and control, on-prem KMS/HSM integration, best fit for regulated workloads and proprietary models that cannot leave your environment.
  * Cons: Most ops overhead (if on-prem), longer procurement and setup, potential higher TCO depending on utilization.

Preliminary sizing checklist (what we need):
- Tokens/day (or tokens/month) and peak QPS by endpoint.
- Concurrency targets (per-request concurrency and number of simultaneous sessions).
- Model types and sizes (e.g., open LLM names and any private model footprints in GB).
- Retention window for KV/prefix cache and audit logs (days).
- Desired latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99).

Estimated cost guidance for the 120 QPS workload (very rough):
- Hosted: fastest path, estimated $15k–$25k/month depending on token volume and caching.
- Dedicated: $18k–$40k/month depending on commit size and GPU types (savings if fully utilized).
- Private: $25k+/month typical (higher setup, depends on on-prem infra amortization).

Questions / Next steps:
1) If you can share tokens/day and model sizes we’ll produce a more accurate cost/model suggestion.
2) If Private is required for EU logs/proprietary model, can you confirm whether you prefer VPC-deployed private control plane (we manage control plane inside your VPC) or fully on-prem package?
3) Marissa / Laura will propose a 30-min technical deep-dive for early next week to go over numbers and POC scope.

I attached a short template for model size & traffic numbers.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

Attachments: sizing_template.xlsx
